title: QuGeo: An End-to-end Quantum Learning Framework for Geoscience - A Case Study on Full-Waveform Inversion
problem: Full-Waveform Inversion in geoscience requires accurate velocity map prediction from seismic data. Current approaches without physics knowledge guidance achieve limited accuracy in velocity reconstruction (SSIM 0.800).
motivation: Identifying high-impact quantum computing applications is critical for realizing quantum's transformative potential in practical domains like geoscience.
method: QuGeo integrates variational quantum circuits specifically designed for FWI with physics-guided data scaling. The framework uses only 576 parameters in the quantum circuit while incorporating physical principles to guide the learning process and improve velocity map accuracy on the OpenFWI FlatVelA dataset.
key_novelty: Application-specific quantum circuit design combined with physics-guided data scaling for FWI, demonstrating that incorporating physical knowledge substantially improves quantum circuit performance over non-physics-informed baselines.
contributions: A quantum learning framework (QuGeo) tailored for geoscientific Full-Waveform Inversion applications
Custom variational quantum circuit design optimized for FWI with only 576 parameters
Physics-guided data scaling methodology ensuring alignment with core physical principles
13.1% SSIM improvement to 0.905 over non-physics-informed baseline on FlatVelA dataset
baselines: baseline FWI without physics knowledge incorporation
primary_theme: quantum machine learning for geoscience inversion
